title: Term covered by an Advance Beneficiary Notice for straight-tip catheters: Urology and Continence Supply Program
content:
On the Continence Original Medicare Program of the Urology and Continence Supply Program, the Advance Beneficiary Notice of Noncoverage for straight-tip intermittent catheters (A4351) covers a term counted in 30-day blocks. A notice for repeated supplies may cover a span of up to one year.

## Clause

The term blocks are set by the order history on the signing date:

1. When the program has an earlier order, the newest written order asks more per 30 days than it, and the newest order is dated no more than 180 calendar days before the signing date, the term blocks are replaced by twelve 30-day blocks. That is the one-year span a notice for repeated supplies may cover.
2. When the program has an earlier order, the newest order asks no more than it, and the newest order is dated no more than 180 calendar days before the signing date, the term blocks are replaced by six.
3. Otherwise the term blocks stay those of one standard shipment. On this tier the standard supply is 90 days, which is 3 blocks.

**Terms used.** The newest written order is the straight-tip order with the latest order date. The previous refill is the program's straight-tip refill with the latest ship date. The earlier order is the written order behind the authorization grant that previous refill drew on. A program with no earlier straight-tip refill has no earlier order.

## Matrix

| Earlier order on file | Newest order compared with it | Newest order dated before signing | Term blocks |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | asks more | 180 days or fewer | 12 |
| yes | asks the same or less | 180 days or fewer | 6 |
| yes | either | more than 180 days | 3 |
| no | not applicable | any | 3 |

*Hypothetical boundary:* an order dated exactly 180 days before the signing date is within the window, and one dated 181 days before is outside it.
